listing.longDescription: Rigorous health and research workflows with deterministic, auditable source retrieval and explicit access boundaries.
starterPrompts: Use AskRigor to research this question with auditable evidence and explicit access gaps.

releaseNotes: Retrieves canonical AskRigor protocol files with byte-derived version and SHA-256 integrity receipts.
Provides 17 read-only tools for scholarly, trial, DOI, and public YouTube source retrieval with explicit provenance and access states.
Preserves pagination, reply reconciliation, rate limits, inaccessible sources, and partial evidence without making clinical conclusions or changing provider data.

developerIdentity.note: The owner reported that the OpenAI portal displays Verifying identity on 2026-08-16; completion has not been observed.

domainVerification.note: Complete the publisher-domain challenge in the signed-in OpenAI portal and retain a non-secret receipt.

scanTools.note: Run Scan Tools against the production MCP endpoint and compare the discovered 17-tool inventory with the committed inventory.

demoRecording.note: Record the bounded reviewer demonstration, upload it to an HTTPS location accepted by the portal, and verify the final URL.

finalPortalReview.note: Review tool annotations, response data, privacy output, listing fields, and policy attestations in the final portal candidate.

submission.note: Submit only after every prerequisite is directly verified and the protected repository candidate is merged.
